title: Sister wedding fund
author: Storytime
hook: My sister asked me to pay for her wedding. Then I found out what she was really planning.
story: So my sister Jenna got engaged last spring, and my whole family acted like it was a royal wedding. Two weeks later she calls me crying. She says the venue wants a twenty thousand dollar deposit by Friday, and since I'm the only one in the family with a stable job, I should help. I said I could give her five thousand, as a gift. She said five thousand was insulting. Fine. I offered to pay the venue directly instead, so the money would be safe. That's when she went quiet. She said the venue only takes payments from the bride. Which is weird, because I called the venue. And here's the thing. There was no booking. No deposit. No wedding date. The venue manager had never heard her name. So I asked my mom what was going on, and she admitted everything. Jenna wasn't planning a wedding at all. She was planning to move across the country with her fiance, and she wanted my money to do it, without telling anyone. Now my parents are mad at me for exposing her, and Jenna says I ruined her fresh start. So, am I the bad guy here? Part two depends on what she did next.
caption: I was supposed to be the maid of honor 💀 #storytime
sound: a low, suspenseful piano or lo-fi sound at very low volume under the voice
why: Money + family + a twist halfway keeps people watching to the end, the open question drives comments and the part 2 hook drives follows.
